cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tipped my plate like yours. Gravity checked. Are those floating sandwiches waiting for gravity, or has it resigned? Choose a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was shaking crumbs off. The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Crumbs cleared. Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

reason: Copied crumb-shaking mistaken for physics check; time and string constraints make selected impossible explanation govern practical serving choice.
